canonical_claim: For every finite family of bounded analytic complex-valued functions on the open unit disc whose pointwise sum of absolute values has a uniform positive lower bound, there is a finite family of bounded analytic functions on the disc whose pointwise Bezout combination with the original family is identically one.
domain_and_universes: A nonempty finite index type and complex-valued functions on the complex open unit disc; the exact finite-family encoding remains open.
quantifiers: existential bounded analytic coefficient family g
hypotheses: every f_i is analytic on the open unit disc
for every point z, delta is at most the sum over i of |f_i(z)|
conclusion: There are bounded analytic g_i such that for every z in the disc, the sum over i of f_i(z) * g_i(z) equals 1.

alternate_encodings.target: the open unit disc is dense in the maximal ideal space of H^infinity
the no-common-zero hypothesis plus an explicit corona constant bound

excluded_degenerate_cases: The empty family is excluded by the positive lower bound; the statement phase must decide zero-dimensional index types, whether boundedness is expressed by a supplied norm bound or Bornology.IsBounded, and whether delta is explicit or existential.
